threat_event: A phished cross-division engineer's identity is used to read station file shares and the WMS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cross-division accounts reach every station; session tokens can be replayed
existing_controls: MFA with number matching; SIEM sign-in analytics
treatment_plan: Token protection policies; assignment-bound access; station-only roles

threat_event: A division-managed laptop with malware connects to a station business network during an outage
threat_source: Malware carried by a contractor device
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Exception list admits division laptops with no device check
existing_controls: EDR required on division laptops by group policy
treatment_plan: Contractor network segment with device posture check

threat_event: A tampered kiosk update infects a PMMD kiosk, which then passes malicious files toward CDAs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Update packages not signature-checked; update server on general subnet
existing_controls: Two scanning engines; CST weekly log review; CDA-side controls under the CSP
treatment_plan: Signature verification; restricted segment; CST release step for every update (CAP entry made)

threat_event: An end-of-support operating system on 2 Station B kiosks is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Kiosk OS out of vendor support since 2025
existing_controls: Kiosks have no general network access beyond the update server
treatment_plan: Replace kiosk OS image; interim use of Station A kiosk procedure for critical transfers (CAP entry made)

threat_event: CDA work packages are exfiltrated from the WMS and used to plan an attack on CDAs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: All about 7,300 users can read CDA details; no bulk-download alert
existing_controls: WMS audit logging to the SIEM
treatment_plan: Restricted CDA module; cyber security sensitive label; bulk download alerts

threat_event: An attachment containing SGI is stored on the WMS and disclosed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual SGI screening of attachments; 2 SGI-marked attachments found in 2026 and removed
existing_controls: SGI training; marking rules
treatment_plan: Automated scan for SGI markings on upload; quarterly sample by the fleet security director

threat_event: A vendor transient laptop bypasses the kiosk and is connected to a Level 3 CDA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor technicians bring their own tools during outages
existing_controls: CSP transient device procedure; escorts; port controls on CDAs
treatment_plan: Outage briefing for vendors; spot checks by the CST (CSP program item)

threat_event: An insider with business network admin rights alters plant data replicas to mislead engineering
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Replica servers trusted by engineering and the Maintenance Rule program
existing_controls: File integrity monitoring; replica administrators in the 73.56 population
treatment_plan: Compare replica data with control room logs for Maintenance Rule decisions

threat_event: A software fault corrupts replica data and leads to a wrong engineering conclusion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Replica data used without a source check
existing_controls: Daily integrity checks
treatment_plan: Data quality checks in engineering procedures

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts station file servers and the WMS during a refueling outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Outage brings 2,500 extra users and devices; flat station server subnet
existing_controls: Immutable backups; EDR; paper clearance and work package fallbacks
treatment_plan: Segment station server subnets; WMS failover test; outage ransomware drill

threat_event: A WMS outage forces paper clearances and an error injures a worker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Paper fallback rarely used at full outage scale
existing_controls: Paper process drilled each outage; independent field verification
treatment_plan: Full-scale paper clearance drill once per outage season

threat_event: No 73.77 notification is made after the group reports a business-network attack to the FBI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group SOC procedures do not flag 73.77(a)(2)(iii)
existing_controls: Station 73.77 procedure; fleet security director on call
treatment_plan: Add the trigger to the group matrix and SOC playbooks; tabletop

threat_event: An attacker reaches the fleet operations center through the corporate network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Interactive remote access path from corporate
existing_controls: Separate ESP; intermediate system with MFA
treatment_plan: ESP rule review; EACMS monitoring

threat_event: Low impact BES Cyber Systems at Station C lack documented vendor electronic remote access controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CIP-003-9 vendor remote access requirements effective 2026-04-01 not yet documented for Station C
existing_controls: Vendor access requires an escort and a station-issued device
treatment_plan: Document methods to determine and disable vendor remote access; update the low impact plan

threat_event: Cross-division accounts stay active between outages and are misused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No end-of-assignment notice; inactivity timer reset by outage logins
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G1 accounts on SYS-N1 and SYS-N2
existing_controls: Quarterly certification
treatment_plan: Assignment-bound access from the outage schedule

threat_event: A bulk download of WMS data goes undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SIEM rule for bulk export
existing_controls: WMS audit logs in SIEM
treatment_plan: Bulk download and unusual query rules

threat_event: The WMS is down for days because failover to provider B fails
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Failover tested only on a copy
existing_controls: Replica in provider B; paper fallbacks
treatment_plan: Production failover test before the next outage season

threat_event: The EAM vendor is breached or ships a malicious update
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor holds admin support access
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 report; federated MFA accounts
treatment_plan: Record vendor sessions; staged releases

threat_event: A hurricane disables Station A business facilities and WAN links
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Coastal site
existing_controls: Station emergency plan; cellular backup links
treatment_plan: Satellite backup link for the work control center

threat_event: Predictive maintenance output shapes maintenance on Maintenance Rule equipment without a 50.65 evaluation, and degradation is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot covers equipment whose failure could cause a reactor trip; alerts auto-create work requests
existing_controls: Time-based preventive maintenance unchanged; engineers review alerts
treatment_plan: Maintenance Rule program review; 73.58 screen; human approval before any work request (P10)

threat_event: Staff apply proposed 73.77 and RG 5.71 changes before a final rule
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Proposed rule 91 FR 38928 widely discussed
existing_controls: Regulatory affairs review of procedure changes
treatment_plan: Regulatory change log; training note to CSTs

threat_event: Unsupported lab and test PCs on the business network are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 41 PCs control lab and test equipment and cannot be upgraded
existing_controls: Host firewall rules; EDR where supported
treatment_plan: Move to an isolated lab segment

threat_event: Unrecorded vendor support sessions to the WMS hide misuse
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Sessions not recorded
existing_controls: Named federated accounts with MFA
treatment_plan: Route vendor sessions through PAM recording

threat_event: Multifunction printers in station security buildings with default admin passwords expose stored images of SGI copies or are used as a foothold
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 printers at Stations A and B had manufacturer default admin passwords; they are networked and were used to copy SGI (found in P07 testing)
existing_controls: Printers behind station firewalls; EDR not supported on printers
treatment_plan: Change passwords; remove SGI copying from networked printers; dedicated stand-alone copier for SGI; storage wipe; CAP entry made

threat_event: Phishing leads to takeover of a station staff email account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High phishing volume during outages
existing_controls: MFA; phishing training; mail filtering
treatment_plan: Outage-specific phishing exercise

threat_event: External transmittals of work packages disclose CDA details to vendors and utilities
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No screening step in the transmittal procedure
existing_controls: Transmittals logged
treatment_plan: Add cyber security sensitive screening to transmittals

threat_event: A site access processing outage delays badging at the start of an outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Peak load in outage week 1
existing_controls: Manual processing of certified packets
treatment_plan: Capacity test before each outage

threat_event: A rogue Wi-Fi access point is attached to a station business network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large contractor population in outages
existing_controls: Wireless intrusion detection
treatment_plan: Accepted: wireless intrusion detection covers it; no CDA wireless exists
owner: Nuclear Generation security and compliance lead

threat_event: An encrypted laptop is stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mobile workforce
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted: encryption makes data exposure unlikely
owner: Nuclear Generation security and compliance lead

threat_event: A CAP system outage delays the 24-hour record of a CSP deficiency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CAP is SaaS
existing_controls: Paper condition report forms with timestamps
treatment_plan: Brief CSTs on the paper path
